lead: A `Core` class a `foreach` walks is not accepted where a `Core` row declares `Iterable<T>`.
body: `Core\IO::writeStream($path, $part->content())` fails as ``expected `array<bytes>|Iterable<bytes>|Iterator<bytes>`, found `Core\Request\PartContent` ``; conforming to `foreach` and to a declared `Iterable<T>` are two questions, only the first answered today. Run `target/debug/nvs test <case>.nvst` before writing the `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` block.
